work_demand: Advise officials within an organization on recommended changes to reconcile differences between an approved budget and actual spending, communicating the recommendations effectively in a written report.
Provide recommendations on cutting spending on particular programs or redistributing extra funds, based on cost-benefit analysis of financial requests, program tradeoffs, and past budgets.

Draft procurement guidelines that set out the criteria buyers and purchasing agents apply when choosing suppliers and merchandise, covering price, quality, availability, reliability, and technical support.
Monitor a software project's progress against deadlines, standards, and cost targets when supervising the project from planning through implementation.
